definitions.explanation: A person or organization that runs a business. Commonly used in legal and regulatory contexts to refer to any entity conducting commercial activity.

examples.japanese: {事業者|じぎょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Business operators have an obligation to follow the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中小|ちゅうしょう}→中小：09953_chuushou⟧{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Support for small and medium-sized businesses was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Telecommunications operators must maintain the quality of their services.

notes:
USAGE:
{事業者|じぎょうしゃ} is a formal term frequently appearing in laws, regulations, and official documents. It covers both individuals and corporations conducting business.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{中小|ちゅうしょう}→中小：09953_chuushou⟧{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: small and medium-sized businesses
- ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: telecommunications operator
- {個人|こじん}{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: sole proprietor
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧{事業者|じぎょうしゃ}: food service operator
- {事業者|じぎょうしゃ}{向|む}け: aimed at businesses (B2B)
